# YQN Logistics

YQN Logistics is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. YQN is China leading international online freight shipping marketplace for freight cargo, container market rates. YQN provides visibility and control, predictable supply chain solutions and fast transit times. YQN Logistics employs 453 people (+30.2% YoY, +105 people). Headquartered in Shanghai, Shanghai, China, operates in 9 countries (including Philippines, United States, Thailand, Singapore, and Japan). Its workforce is distributed across 12 countries (including China, United States, Hong Kong, Mexico, and Vietnam).

## About

Founded in 2015 and headquartered in Shanghai, YQN Logistics is deeply rooted in China’s logistics network, with offices in all major Chinese port cities. We maintain strong relationships with 300+ shipping and airline partners and 3,500+ supplier resources, delivering competitive rates on key trade lanes such as China–Southeast Asia, China–Latin America, China–Middle East, and China–EuroMed.

With 25 offices worldwide and 1,500+ employees, we provide end-to-end international freight services — including ocean, air, rail, multimodal transportation, trucking, customs clearance, insurance, global warehousing, and destination services — backed by quick response and professional operations.

Our warehouses in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico offer over 4 million sq. ft. of storage and integrate seamlessly with leading e-commerce platforms like Amazon, Walmart, and TikTok Shop, enabling efficient cross-border fulfillment.

Meanwhile, our digital platform gives businesses instant access to freight rates and real-time cargo tracking.

Ship from China, Go YQN!
